title.narrative: In the first half of 2024, the office continued to build on the achievements of 2023, further strengthening Programme planning, monitoring, and evaluation. The implementation of the Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) has progressed significantly, ensuring up-to-date statistics on the situation of children and women. Additionally, the PME Section has completed one evaluation and two studies, ensuring the availability of current data to monitor the situation of children and inform targeted interventions.;
